sources.title: 菲尔兹奖得主加州大学伯克利分校教授因人工智能作弊而结束作业评分 / Fields Medal-winning UC Berkeley professor ends graded homework due to AI cheating
sources.title_zh: 菲尔兹奖得主加州大学伯克利分校教授因人工智能作弊而结束作业评分
sources.title_en: Fields Medal-winning UC Berkeley professor ends graded homework due to AI cheating
sources.title_original: Fields Medal-winning UC Berkeley professor ends graded homework due to AI cheating
sources.summary: Award-winning mathematician Richard Brocherds says that it's a waste of time and money to grade AI answers, so he now only uses in-person exams to see how well his students are doing in his classes.
sources.summary_zh: 屡获殊荣的数学家理查德·布罗彻兹 (Richard Brocherds) 表示，对人工智能答案进行评分是浪费时间和金钱，因此他现在只使用现场考试来了解学生在课堂上的表现。

stories.title: 亚马逊告诉工程师停止“tokenmaxshing”以看起来更有效率 / Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive

sources.title: 亚马逊告诉工程师停止“tokenmaxshing”以看起来更有效率 / Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive
sources.title_zh: 亚马逊告诉工程师停止“tokenmaxshing”以看起来更有效率
sources.title_en: Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive
sources.title_original: Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive
sources.summary: Amazon has published new engineering guidelines warning developers and managers against ‘tokenmaxxing,’ arguing that AI usage metrics are ‘deeply flawed’ unless tied to long-term outcomes. The move follows similar spending concerns at Uber and Accenture.
sources.summary_zh: 亚马逊发布了新的工程指南，警告开发人员和管理人员不要“tokenmaxshing”，认为人工智能使用指标“存在严重缺陷”，除非与长期结果挂钩。此前，优步和埃森哲也对支出存在类似担忧。
